title.primary: Dune Bashing & BBQ Dinner Desert Safari — Dubai
title.ab_variant: Experience the Thrill of Dune Bashing & Dinner in Dubai

listing.tagline: Feel the adrenaline rush of dune bashing followed by a feast under the stars.

short.primary: Get ready for an exhilarating evening in the Dubai desert, complete with thrilling dune bashing, a camel ride, and a delicious BBQ dinner. Your adventure starts with hotel pickup and lasts for 6 unforgettable hours.
short.ab_variant: Skip the hassle of planning and dive into an action-packed desert safari. Enjoy dune bashing, a camel ride, and a mouthwatering BBQ feast—all included!

section_1.header: Embark on an Unforgettable Desert Adventure
section_1.body: Feel the rush as you cruise through the stunning dunes of Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve in a 4x4 Land Cruiser. This isn’t just any safari; it's a heart-pounding ride that lasts 45 minutes, led by expert drivers who know how to navigate the terrain.

section_2.body: After the adrenaline of dune bashing, hop on a camel for a lap around the camp, then try your hand at sandboarding. As the sun sets, you'll be welcomed into a traditional Bedouin camp where a delectable BBQ dinner awaits, featuring grilled meats and refreshing drinks.

section_3.body: Let the rhythm of belly dancing and the mesmerizing Tanoura show captivate you as you dine. Don’t forget to capture memories with a falcon—a unique photography opportunity that adds an unforgettable touch to your desert experience.

section_4.body: Your adventure begins with a pickup from your hotel in Dubai. Be ready in your hotel lobby 5 minutes before your scheduled pickup at 3:30 PM. Expect to return around 9:30 PM, filled with memories of a truly unique experience.

inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off (Dubai city hotels only)
Dune bashing in shared 4x4 Land Cruiser
Camel riding (1 lap around the camp)
exclusions: Shisha (available at camp for AED 50 additional)
Quad biking (can be arranged on request)
important_information: Dune bashing is not recommended for pregnant women or those with certain health conditions.
Children under 3 must be secured in a child seat, which we provide on request.
Guests should wear comfortable, modest clothing and light layers for the evening.

know_before_you_go.accessibility: This experience may not be suitable for those with mobility issues due to the nature of the terrain and activities involved.
additional: Weather conditions can impact the tour, so stay informed and check cancellation policies.

faqs.question: What is the pickup location?
faqs.answer: We collect guests from their hotel lobby in Dubai. Please be ready 5 minutes before your pickup time.

faqs.question: What time does the safari start?
faqs.answer: The safari departs daily at 3:30 PM, with all pickups completed by 4:15 PM.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before the tour start time. No refunds for cancellations made within 24 hours.

faqs.question: Is this experience suitable for children?
faqs.answer: Yes, children aged 3-11 can join the safari at a reduced price. Children under 3 are free but must be secured in a child seat.

faqs.question: What is included in the tour?
faqs.answer: The tour includes hotel pickup and drop-off, dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, BBQ dinner, and entertainment.

faqs.question: Is tower access guaranteed?
faqs.answer: Tower access is included but not guaranteed. It may be temporarily closed for maintenance or during high-wind conditions.

faqs.question: What should I wear?
faqs.answer: Guests should wear comfortable, modest clothing and light layers for the evening.

@graph.name: Evening Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Camel Ride & BBQ Dinner in Dubai
@graph.description: Experience the thrill of a Dubai Desert Safari with our flagship evening tour. Departing daily from Dubai city hotels, guests are whisked away to the stunning Al Marmoom Desert Conservation Reserve. Enjoy an exhilarating 45 minutes of dune bashing in our 4x4 Land Cruisers, driven by professional guides. After the adrenaline rush, take a camel ride and try your hand at sandboarding on the golden dunes. As the sun sets, indulge in a traditional Bedouin-style BBQ buffet dinner featuring a variety of grilled meats, mezze, and refreshing beverages. The evening is filled with entertainment, including captivating belly dancing and a mesmerizing Tanoura show. Capture unforgettable moments with our falcon photography opportunity.

priceSpecification.description: 100% refund if cancelled 24+ hours before start
